title: LikenessAsk
description: PERUSE-2026-10-25. One ask for a pictured household adult's consent to a single picture or video of adult content that looks like them. The pictured adult reads the exact prompt on a card and clicks Consent or Decline; one ask covers one generation. The prompt text is never in this record, only its SHA-256, so the record can be kept as the audit trail.

subject_person_id.description: The household adult who is asked.

requester_person_id.description: The adult who asked for the picture or video.

way.description: style: a saved style of the person. Adult content from a photo is never allowed.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact prompt shown on the card.

source.description: Where the request was made; this is the record provenance.

decided_by.description: Which of the two accounts the click was made from. Home does not check who holds the device.
